stories.title: Maksim Vladimirovich Poletaev v. Uzbekistan — new case registered at ICSID
stories.summary: Maksim Vladimirovich Poletaev and Solfy RUS, Russian investors, have registered a claim at ICSID against Uzbekistan under the BIT Russian Federation - Uzbekistan 2013, in the finance sector. Amsterdam & Partners LLP and E L W I act for the claimants. Ministry of Justice, Department on Legal Protection of Interests of Uzbekistan for Uzbekistan. The tribunal has not yet been constituted.
counsel: Ministry of Justice, Department on Legal Protection of Interests of Uzbekistan, Tashkent, Uzbekistan
